23:75.text: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

23:76.text: And We had gripped them with suffering
, but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate,

23:77.text: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.

23:78.text: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts

23:79.text: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.

23:80.text: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?

23:81.text: they say like what the former peoples said.

23:82.text: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

23:83.text: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

23:84.text: , "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"

23:85.text: They will say, "To Allāh." Say, "Then will you not remember?"

23:86.text: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"

23:87.text: to Allāh." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

23:88.text: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"

23:89.text: to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
